definitions.explanation: The external shape or physical form of an object. A somewhat formal or technical term compared to the everyday word 形 (かたち).

examples.japanese: {形状|けいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特殊|とくしゅ}→特殊：04566_tokushu⟧な{形状|けいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This product has a unique shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{形状|けいじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}した→設計する：26916_sekkeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The building was designed to match the shape of the land.

notes:
USAGE:
{形状|けいじょう} is more formal and technical than ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (shape). It is preferred in product descriptions, technical specifications, scientific writing, and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {形状|けいじょう}⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦{合金|ごうきん}→合金：17137_goukin⟧ (shape-memory alloy)
- {形状|けいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain shape)
- ⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧な{形状|けいじょう} (irregular shape)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ is the everyday word for "shape." {形状|けいじょう} is preferred in written or technical contexts.
